questions.q: What does one bootstrap resample consist of?
options: Drawing n observations from your original sample without replacement
Drawing n observations from your original sample with replacement
Collecting a brand-new sample from the population
Removing outliers from the sample
questions.explain: A bootstrap resample is the same size as the original sample, drawn from it with replacement, so some values repeat and others are left out.

questions.q: Why is the bootstrap especially useful for a statistic like the median?
options: The median is always normally distributed
There is no simple standard-error formula for the median, but resampling still estimates its spread
The bootstrap removes skew from the median
It makes the sample larger
questions.explain: The bootstrap needs only the ability to compute the statistic on each resample, so it works where formulas are messy or unavailable.

questions.q: How do you form a 95% percentile bootstrap interval?
options: Add and subtract 1.96 from the original statistic
Take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the bootstrapped statistics
Take the minimum and maximum of the bootstrapped statistics
Take the mean of the bootstrapped statistics
questions.explain: The middle 95% of the bootstrap distribution, between its 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, gives the interval.

questions.q: A bootstrap interval for the difference between two group means is -12.1 to 15.8. What can you conclude?
options: The groups are definitely identical
Group B is definitely larger
The interval includes zero, so the data cannot clearly distinguish the groups
The bootstrap failed
questions.explain: A range that includes zero means a difference of zero is a plausible value, so the data do not provide clear evidence of a difference. It does not prove they are identical.

questions.q: Which is a genuine limitation of the bootstrap?
options: It cannot fix a biased sample, because it only resamples the data you already have
It only works for means
It requires the data to be normally distributed
It needs a known population standard deviation
questions.explain: The bootstrap treats the sample as the population, so any bias in how the sample was collected carries straight through.
